title: handoff packet
description: One agent to agent handoff between the sapphire and twixtor repositories: a task, its inputs, the stage chain to run, what the result must look like, and later the result. Identical in both repositories. Only the keywords type, required, properties, additionalProperties, enum, items, pattern, minimum, maximum, minLength and const are used, so tools/handoff.py validates it without a library.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema; a reader refuses any other value.

id.description: <UTC time as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>-<from>-<to>-<6 hex digits>; also the file name stem under handoff/.

created.description: ISO 8601 UTC, second precision, when the sender wrote the packet.

updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC, second precision, of the last replacement of the file.

from.description: The repository whose agent sends the task.

to.description: The repository whose agent receives the task and keeps the packet in its handoff/ folder.

task.description: What the receiver is asked to do, in plain words.

status.description: new (written by the sender), accepted (the receiver took it), done (result recorded), failed (the receiver reports failure), verified (a verify passed on a done packet).

inputs.description: Files the task starts from. A raw frame input carries its geometry; any other file has null geometry.

path.description: Absolute path, or relative to the root of the repository that holds the packet.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file bytes.

depth.description: Bits per channel of the raw frame format: 8 rgba, 16 rgba64le, 32 gbrapf32le.

fps.description: Exact rate as numerator/denominator, for example 30000/1001.

frames.description: Whole frames in the file; null when the file is not raw frames.

request.description: The stage chain the receiver runs, first stage first.

stage.description: Stage or effect id, as `list --json` of the tool shows it.

params.description: Parameter id to value text, passed through unchanged as --param K=V.

layers.description: Layer id to file path, passed through as --layer ID=PATH.

expect.description: What a correct result looks like; verify checks it.

frames.description: Whole frames every output holds; null for no expectation.

size.description: Bytes of every output file; null for no expectation.

determinism.description: exact: a replay returns the recorded bytes; tolerance: a replay stays within the tolerance below; none: no claim about a replay.

max_abs_diff.description: Largest allowed difference of one sample, in code values at depth 8 and 16 and in float units at depth 32.

max_diff_fraction.description: Largest allowed fraction of samples that differ at all.

result.description: null until the receiver records the run with done.

commands.description: The commands that ran, in order, without a shell. verify --replay runs them again.

stdin.description: File fed to standard input, or null.

stdout.description: File that received standard output, or null when it was discarded.

cwd.description: Working directory; null means the root of the repository that holds the packet.

scratch.description: Folder the run kept its intermediate files in, so a cut off agent can find them; null when none.

notes.description: Status changes and free notes, oldest first.
